# prr

AI code review for GitHub pull requests and local Git branches.

- Repository: https://github.com/smeltery/prr
- Documentation source: https://github.com/smeltery/prr/tree/master/docs
- Install: go install github.com/smeltery/prr@latest
- Default agent: claude-cli; verification enabled by default.
- Reviews write local Markdown. prr post explicitly submits a GitHub review.
- The --since flag is accepted but currently does not change review scope.
